name: Files Studio
description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other OpenDAL services.
releaseNotes: 新增 Google Cloud Storage、Azure Blob、华为 OBS，以及阿里云盘、Dropbox、Google Drive、Koofr、OneDrive、pCloud、Seafile、Yandex Disk 等 OpenDAL 云存储服务，并同步扩充连接表单契约与协议矩阵测试。Adds Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, Huawei OBS, plus Alibaba Drive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Koofr, OneDrive, pCloud, Seafile, and Yandex Disk, with expanded connection-form and protocol-matrix coverage.

zh-CN.name: Files Studio
zh-CN.description: 统一管理本地文件夹、S3 兼容存储、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、华为 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 等 OpenDAL 服务的文件工作台：传输任务、归档与受控运维集中在一个界面。
